material.acceptance_criteria: A panic injected into the ticker is caught and logged as one ev=ticker_died line, the room logs one ev=ticker_restarted line, and /state tick advances within 2 seconds of the restart line. Snapshot rollback is out of scope.
material.description: rust/crates/server/src/supervise.rs wraps the ticker (room.rs spawn_ticker) and the mod thread (mods.rs spawn) in catch_unwind with a bounded restart. Owner decision (witness-log.md, 2026-10-17T20:08:59Z): acceptance is tick continuity without per-tick rollback; state rollback is not implemented.
material.subject: Ticker and mod threads restart after a panic; the room resumes ticking within 2 seconds
material.witness: Verifier lane gm-orch-1-r1-verify ran the ticker-panic witness against e03ee19 (CI step: --test-panic-tick 20, one ticker_died, one ticker_restarted, tick 21->35 within the 2 s bound, unarmed run died=0). CI ci job success on e03ee19 (run 39065-series, sha e03ee19).
material.witness_plan: ci.yml step 'Arm one ticker panic...' starts oscraftd with --test-panic-tick 20, asserts one ticker_died and one ticker_restarted line, then polls /state for a tick advance with a 2-second bound; an unarmed run logs zero ticker_died. The mod-thread step (ci.yml 'mod thread panic') already covers mod_thread_died/restarted.
